function: Locates the hook guides, pin stand and tail support on a common base.
Holds the purchased hook as the operator slides and rolls it.
Supports the carrier journal at each of the two guide stations.
Closes each split guide around the journal while allowing translation and rotation.
Sets the carrier’s home end of travel.
Guides the two steel pins as they enter and withdraw from the foundation chain.
Couples both pins so the operator can retract them together.
Carries the clip that holds the foundation tail.
Presents the working strand to the hook through a smooth eye.
Checks the prepared chain opening before it goes on the pins.
Provides candidate bores for checking printed sliding fits.
Mates with the slide-fit coupon to check rotation and sliding.
Checks how purchased rod and nuts fit the printed features.
Reproduces a clamp feature for checking nut capture and rod retention.
Forms the loop.
Hold the target opening on either side of the hook path.
Secure the stands and guides to the base.
Fasten the upper and lower guide halves.
Center the purchased hook in its carrier.
Secure the rods and the carrier stop.
Receive the mounting and clamp screws.
Spread the screw-head load on the mounts and guides.
Anchors the foundation tail at its stand.
Temporarily holds the working strand.
